name: Move Zoom data to Google Bigquery
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Zoom** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Google BigQuery data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Zoom** account using the **(+)** icon with your **Account Id, Client Id & Client secret** of the server-to-server app**.** Read more about the setup guide [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/myntra/setup.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/zoom/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
